text:
**LinkedIn post:**

Meet Le Chonk 🧀, Mistral Large 4, now on Hugging Face.

It's a multimodal, multilingual Mixture-of-Experts model with about 1T total parameters, 49B active, and a 1M-token context window. It takes text and images in and generates text.

The part that stood out to me is cybersecurity.

📊 It scores 82% on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index task, which asks a model to reproduce a real vulnerability in open-source software and then patch it. Mistral reports that several closed frontier models score near zero on the same test because they refuse to attempt the work.

Defenders have to reproduce a vulnerability before they can fix it. Security work often looks like an attack in a model's input, so closed filters can block it, and an API-dependent team can lose access mid-incident. With open weights, the usage policy and the deployment stay in your hands.

It still declines harmful requests. On cyber prompts from JailbreakBench, StrongREJECT and AgentHarm, its average refusal rate is higher than any other open-weight model.

Other highlights:
🔹 Cybench: solves 93% of 40 security-competition challenges
🔹 Coding Agent Index: 49.8%, ahead of DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 and Qwen3.8 Max
🔹 Fifth best open-weights model on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index (as of Oct 29, 2026)
🔹 93.3% attack resistance on Lakera's B3 prompt-injection benchmark

Under the hood:
⚙️ 128 experts, with 4 routed plus 1 shared active per token
⚙️ Multi-head Latent Attention with a DeepSeek Sparse Attention indexer
⚙️ A 1.6B Pixtral vision encoder

It also has day-0 support across the ecosystem:
✅ Transformers, vLLM and llama.cpp
✅ Fine-tuning with TRL
✅ Hugging Face Inference Endpoints and Dell Enterprise Hub
✅ GGUF quants, where the 2-bit versions run on a single 512 GB Apple Silicon Ultra machine

Because reproduce-then-patch tasks have verifiable rewards, they fit RL environments well. I'd expect the community to use this model to train smaller, specialized security models.

It's released under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License, an MIT derivative that limits model-as-a-service offerings.

What would you build with it? 👇

#OpenSource #AI #LLM #Cybersecurity #HuggingFace #MistralAI #MachineLearning

**Note:** The article says "49B active" in the intro but the model ID reads "A52B." I used the article's 49B figure. You may want to verify it before posting.
